kb.a: Conquest AI is our done-for-you AI system. We build and run an AI receptionist, follow-ups and automations in your CRM, give you a dedicated AI agent for your business, and Mission Control so you can see it all. It carries your brand, not ours.

kb.q: What does the AI receptionist do?
kb.a: It answers calls 24/7 in your business name, handles common questions the way you would, books consults on your calendar, and texts or emails your pricing and a pay link while the caller is still interested. Then it follows up with the ones who go quiet.

It's an AI agent that works only for your business. It handles follow-ups, task tracking and reports, builds automations in your CRM, and takes on research, content drafts and admin. If a task needs a person, our team steps in.

kb.q: Do I own my leads and data?
kb.a: Yes. It's built on your own phone number and accounts, so you own the leads and the data.

kb.q: Will the AI say something wrong?
kb.a: It only says what you approve, it doesn't promise results, and it sticks to your script and required disclosures. You hear it and sign off before it ever talks to a customer.

It starts with one consultation call. What you tell us becomes a proposal page in your brand. After you enroll, you fill out an onboarding form, and you go live about 2 weeks after your texting registration is approved.
Pricing depends on what we build for you, and we go over it on your consultation call.

tiles.hintTouch: Tap or swipe the busywork away

stages.p: It starts with one consultation call. What you tell us becomes a proposal page in your brand, with your problems in your own words and the automations we'll build to fix them.
Your AI receptionist answers calls 24/7 and books consults on your calendar. Speed-to-lead, reminders and follow-ups run in your CRM, on your own number, so you own the leads and the data.

stages.h: A dedicated agent for your business.
stages.p: Your own AI agent learns your business and handles the work. A real person on our team reviews it, and nothing goes out to your customers until you've approved it.
Mission Control shows today's activity, your leads and what needs you, with a usage gauge so you always know what's running.
